model.title: Secure Space Act of 2026
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. Deb Fischer (R-NE)

summary.text: The bill would prohibit the Federal Communications Commission from licensing satellite systems or authorizing ground stations to foreign entities and their affiliates identified as national security risks. It aims to prevent companies deemed to pose an unacceptable risk to U.S. national security—such as certain Chinese telecommunications equipment providers—from gaining access to American satellite communications infrastructure.
